items.title: Earl Watkins interviewed by Monk Rowe, San Francisco, California, August 7, 2002
items.q: The Glenn Miller band, they came here, I saw them over at Sweet’s Ballroom.

ctx.x: But that’s what would happen here. See before the war, we didn’t have that many big bands. You had Vaudeville, but the only time you’d really have a big band would be when they came out to make a movie, see cause the transportation costs were prohibitive I guess at that time. So when there would be a picture, then the band, they would come right up the coast, up to Seattle and then back East again. The Glenn Miller band, they came here, I saw them over at Sweet’s Ballroom. They did a couple of pictures here. One…
Sun Valley Serenade or something like that.
